coverage.samplingNote: Curated current families and fixed shapes, with a small explicit legal flex grid. Counts do not describe all possible configurable machines.
coverage.memoryUnitBasis: Provider-published GB retained without numerical conversion. Oracle does not specify the byte convention on the shape page; the legacy GiB field holds this nominal capacity, not a verified binary-byte measurement.
exclusions: Retired P100 and previous-generation CPU shapes
Sales-contact-only HPC and dense-I/O E5/E6 shapes
GB200/GB300/B300/MI355X shapes with inconsistent published memory capacities
Spot, commitments, negotiated prices, dedicated VM hosts, Windows and AI Enterprise license add-ons

coverage.scope: Dallas regional public USD full-share multi-tenant Linux base prices for exact named profiles. Public plans are filtered to ordinary-access CPU and generally available L4/L40S GPU families.
coverage.exclusions: Generic component plans, reserved/Spot/dedicated-host/fractional-share meters, paid OS add-ons, nano/confidential/high-frequency profiles and select-availability accelerators. No prices inferred from another profile.

sourceAttributions.title: Spare Cores cloud server benchmark measurements
sourceAttributions.creator: Spare Cores
sourceAttributions.changes: Selected AWS, Azure and GCP Linux Geekbench CPU task results; parsed scores, metadata and hardware; joined nominal public catalog specifications; rejected incomplete, failed and mismatched runs. No scores estimated or rescaled.

benchmarkBasis.cpu: Geekbench 6.1–6.7 multi-core, Linux without SME, exact VM shape and full vCPU count; no score scaling
benchmarkBasis.gpu: Geekbench 7 OpenCL hardware-model reference; a labeled proxy for a single allocated GPU

gpu.explanation: Estimate a CPU-and-RAM baseline from CPU-only VMs, then fit a multiplicative GPU increment to the positive remaining price. Add the two fitted contributions. Nonpositive residuals cause a fit to be rejected; they are never discarded.

validation.method: Nested provider × machine-family holdouts: choose the model form and ridge penalty on inner training-family folds, then predict the untouched outer family. CPU-baseline training excludes both inner and outer withheld families.

bootstrap.resamplingMethod: Stratified family bootstrap: resample GPU families with replacement and use the same multiplicities for their CPU rows; independently resample the remaining CPU-only families. The selected method is held fixed.

warnings: GPU scores are hardware-model proxies. The fitted response is the whole VM rental, including CPU and system RAM.
5 GPU machine families cover 37 configurations; repeated GPU models and related sizes are not independent hardware measurements.
This is nested cross-validation on the observed sample, not a separate prospective test. Future pricing and new GPU generations can differ.
The CPU baseline and GPU increment are estimated contributions, not provider component charges. Both stages are refitted without each withheld family.
A negative exponent describes correlations in this sample, not a claim that adding that resource causes a discount.

selection.criterion: Mean squared log-price error, averaged equally over inner held-out machine families. Only candidates with complete inner validation are eligible.
